description: An acoustic cover of a Hindi song: one singer with a guitar, a single fixed shot

annotation.video_summary: A young man performs an acoustic guitar and vocal cover of the Hindi song 'Maa' from the film Taare Zameen Par in a domestic bedroom setting.
annotation.title_promise: An acoustic guitar cover and emotional vocal performance of the song Maa.

beats.summary: The creator plays the fingerstyle guitar intro to set up the song.

beats.transcript: Main kabhi batlata nahin par andhere se darta hoon main maa. Yoon toh main dikhlata nahin, teri parwah karta hoon main maa. Tujhe sab hai pata, hai na maa? Tujhe sab hai pata, meri maa. Bheed mein yoon na chhodo mujhe, ghar laut ke bhi aa na paun maa. Bhejna itna door mujhko tu, yaad bhi tujhko na aa paun maa. Kya itna bura hoon main maa? Kya itna bura hoon main maa?
beats.summary: He sings the opening verses and chorus while playing acoustic guitar.
He performs an instrumental acoustic guitar interlude between verses.

beats.transcript: Jab bhi kabhi papa mujhe zor zor se jhhula jhhulate hain maa, meri nazar dhoondhe tujhe, sochoon yehi tu aake thaamegi maa. Unse main yeh kehta nahin, par main seham jaata hoon maa. Chehre pe aane deta nahin, dil hi dil mein ghabrata hoon maa. Tujhe sab hai pata, hai na maa? Tujhe sab hai pata, meri maa.
beats.summary: He sings the emotional second section and chorus of the song.
He plays the acoustic guitar outro rhythm to conclude the song.
He pauses, waves goodbye to the camera, and reaches to stop recording.
